CVtoMatch — AI Resume to Job Matcher, ATS Checker & LinkedIn Recruiter Radar

CVtoMatch (cvtomatch.com) is an AI-powered career intelligence and job matching platform. Match your CV against any job description in seconds with our 6-factor NLP ATS Resume Matcher, discover live LinkedIn hiring posts with verified corporate recruiter emails, generate tailored AI cover letters, and track your job applications in one workspace.

Core Capabilities

  • 6-Factor ATS Resume Matcher: Evaluate Technical Skills, TF-IDF Keywords, Title Alignment, Seniority Fit, Must-Haves, and Soft Skills.
  • Live LinkedIn Recruiter Post Radar: Bypass crowded job portals and contact hiring managers directly using verified corporate emails.
  • AI Cover Letter & Direct Outreach: Generate role-specific cover letters and send job applications from your connected email account.
  • Kanban Application Tracker: Organize and track every job application from Applied to Interview and Offer.
